question_en: What's the wifi password?
provenance: 23% of pre-check-in messages ask about wifi (StayPilot, n=500)

question_es: ¿El wifi funciona en la playa / en todas las habitaciones?
question_en: Does the wifi work on the beach / in every room?
provenance: Coverage-dependent; test retrieval over a prose amenity page

question_en: Is wifi free in the room?
provenance: Free vs paid is money-adjacent: must come from structured data

question_es: No me conecta el wifi de la habitación 214
question_en: The wifi won't connect in room 214
provenance: In-stay access failure: 42% of access messages report something broken (Conduit)

question_en: What time is check-in?
provenance: Top pre-arrival question #1 (Viqal: top 5 = 60-70% of pre-arrival)

question_es: ¿Puedo hacer el check-in antes de las 15:00?
question_en: Can I check in before 3pm?
provenance: Early check-in is the #1 request (1,131 of 10,000 conversations, Runnr); priced when available

question_es: Llego a las 23:30, ¿la recepción estará abierta?
question_en: I arrive at 11:30pm - will reception be open?
provenance: Late arrival is a handoff risk if unstaffed

question_es: ¿Puedo dejar las maletas antes de la entrada?
question_en: Can I store my bags before check-in?
provenance: Luggage storage is a top-5 concierge request

question_es: ¿A qué hora hay que dejar la habitación?
question_en: What time is checkout?
provenance: Departure logistics = 26.6% of departure-day messages

question_en: Can I have a late checkout at 2pm?
provenance: Late checkout is #2 timing request; must not promise without availability

question_es: ¿Puedo dejar el equipaje después del check-out?
question_en: Can you keep my luggage after checkout?
provenance: Same as C08 but post-stay

question_es: ¿Qué horario tiene el desayuno y dónde se sirve?
question_en: What time is breakfast, and where is it served?
provenance: One of the 5 questions front desks answer ~200x/day (qreadible)

question_es: ¿El desayuno está incluido en mi tarifa?
question_en: Is breakfast included in my rate?
provenance: Rate-dependent: must never assume; escalate if booking not linked

question_en: How much is the breakfast buffet?
provenance: Price: structured data only

question_en: How late does the restaurant serve?
provenance: Meal-plan and hours questions are a top-3 HiJiffy category

question_en: Do you have gluten-free or vegan options?
provenance: Dietary needs: high-stakes if wrong

question_en: Do you have parking, and how much is it?
provenance: 14% of pre-check-in messages (StayPilot); top-4 guest request (Runnr)

question_en: Can I charge an electric car?
provenance: Deliberate KB gap: tests the decline path

question_en: Do you offer airport transfers?
provenance: Top-5 pre-arrival topic; transfer is a revenue line

question_en: Can you call me a taxi at 6am?
provenance: Action request: confirm process, do not promise the action itself

question_en: What are the pool hours?
provenance: Amenity hours are a top-5 volume category

question_en: Is the pool heated?
provenance: Deliberate KB gap: a classic hallucination trap

question_en: Is the gym free for guests?
provenance: Fee question: structured data only

question_en: Do you have massage, and what does it cost?
provenance: Price list must come from offers, never from retrieved prose

question_en: Do I need to book the spa in advance?
Do you accept pets?
provenance: Top-5 pre-arrival topic

question_es: ¿Qué nos recomienda hacer hoy en la zona?
question_en: What would you recommend doing nearby today?
provenance: Local recommendations: a named top-5 category

question_es: ¿Me pueden traer toallas a la habitación?
question_en: Could I get extra towels in my room?
provenance: In-stay request: handoff to housekeeping, no silent promise

question_en: Can I cancel my booking free of charge?
provenance: Cancellation is a top-5 phone question; never invent terms

question_es: ¿Me pueden subir a una suite sin coste?
question_en: Can you upgrade me to a suite for free?
provenance: Deliberate gap: no upgrade policy in KB; must offer a human
